title: MiniQMT strategy execution bypasses StrategyPackage minute_execution_policy and uses SelectionOrderBuilder to emit broker orders
description:
Expected: MiniQMT simulated/live-like strategy execution must follow the StrategyPackage contract: daily strategy produces selection signals and target portfolio/rebalance intent; the configured execution policy such as V25_1_SMALL_CAP generates executable child orders; QmtManagedOrderService only preflights/submits orders to MiniQMT. A package with minute_execution_policy must never silently bypass that policy. For current daily long-only rebalance semantics, selected holdings should not be partially reduced just because target_quantity recomputation is below current holdings; dropped holdings should be sold according to the strategy rebalance rule.
Actual: The current MiniQMT virtual strategy POC path uses backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger/selection_order_builder.py. It converts SelectionRun plus virtual position lots directly into ManagedOrderRequest objects and submits/preview-preflights those orders through QmtManagedOrderService. This bypasses StrategyPackage.minute_execution_policy and does not invoke V25_1_SMALL_CAP. It also treats target_quantity - current_quantity as a direct rebalance delta and emits REDUCE_TO_TARGET sell orders for still-selected stocks, producing invalid partial-reduce behavior such as 688193.SH SELL 73 when the strategy should follow backtest-style daily selection/rebalance semantics.
reproduce_command: rg -n "SelectionOrderBuilder|minute_execution_policy|V25_1_SMALL_CAP|REDUCE_TO_TARGET|target_quantity - current_quantity|delta = target_quantity" backend/services/qmt_strategy_ledger backend/routers/qmt_strategy_ledger.py backend/execution_algos backend/services/trading_core -S
required_verification: MiniQMT strategy-package execution fails fast when the validated MiniQMT execution bridge is missing.
SelectionOrderBuilder direct broker-order generation is disabled by default for StrategyPackage execution.
Regression tests cover the 688193-like REDUCE_TO_TARGET failure shape through the disabled direct path and preserve legacy calculator tests behind an explicit test-only flag.
Managed manual order preview/submit remains available through QmtManagedOrderService and does not use SelectionOrderBuilder.
closure_requirements: The /package-bindings/{binding_id}/orders/preview endpoint no longer returns broker-order requests from SelectionOrderBuilder for active StrategyPackage bindings.
Operators receive a structured UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE fail-fast response that names BUG-077 and the required validated execution-policy bridge.
Future implementation of the MiniQMT execution bridge must consume StrategyPackage alpha core, daily target/rebalance intent, and validated execution policy before broker submission.

events.note: Evidence: SelectionOrderBuilder was introduced by commit d15376d feat(qmt): add miniqmt multi-strategy ledger workflow, not by MiniQMT/xtquant.
Observed POC path: Selection Run -> SelectionOrderBuilder -> QmtManagedOrderService -> MiniQMT.
Expected path: StrategyPackage -> daily selection/target rebalance intent -> V25_1_SMALL_CAP minute execution plan -> child orders -> QmtManagedOrderService -> MiniQMT.

Observed invalid order evidence from 2026-05-20 POC: order_remark D0520A_S03_688193SH, 688193.SH SELL 73, metadata rebalance_reason=REDUCE_TO_TARGET, target_quantity=3527, current_quantity=3600, available_quantity=3600, requested_quantity=73.
Business impact: the most basic StrategyPackage execution promise is violated; current MiniQMT POC validates ledger/order attribution/broker submit/sync only, not true strategy-package execution.

Required fix: fail-fast when a package declares minute_execution_policy but no MiniQMT execution bridge exists, or implement the bridge so configured V25_1_SMALL_CAP generates broker child orders. Remove/disable direct broker-order generation from SelectionOrderBuilder for strategy-package execution.
Mirrored BUG-077 to GitHub issue #104 via gh CLI after MCP sync lacked GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
Confirmed GitHub issue #104 is open and label-synced.
Fix branch bug/BUG-077-miniqmt-strategy-execution-boundary disables SelectionOrderBuilder direct broker-order generation by default and adds fail-fast regression coverage.

Targeted BUG-077 tests passed: pytest backend/tests/qmt_strategy_ledger/test_selection_order_builder.py backend/tests/qmt_strategy_ledger/test_router_summary.py -q -p no:cacheprovider -> 21 passed in 9.43s.
Full qmt_strategy_ledger suite passed: pytest backend/tests/qmt_strategy_ledger -q -p no:cacheprovider -> 86 passed in 9.01s.
Trading-core related regression passed: pytest backend/tests/trading_core backend/tests/unified_engine/test_qe_config_truth.py -q -p no:cacheprovider -> 126 passed in 10.45s.
compileall, validation_module_registry_l0, l0, git diff --check, and git diff --cached --check passed; production 8001/3000, DB, and MiniQMT broker runtime were not touched.
Fix committed locally as 6de7d16 fix(qmt): block legacy selection order strategy execution; branch passed targeted, module, trading-core, compile, guardrail, l0, and diff checks.
